'''Wing 2''' was the callsign of a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Warship/Legends|warship]] that served during the [[Freedon Nadd Uprising]].

==History==
Wing 2 reported in during the initial attack run of the Republic fleet over [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]].
